title: MPLS
readonly: Your role cannot change the configuration

path.recursive: recursive MPLS (VPP does not report the via label)

interfaces.intro: Interfaces that accept labelled packets, and additional MPLS tables for label routes that should not live in the default MPLS table.
interfaces.table0: MPLS table 0 is the default MPLS table. It is shared by the whole system: enabling MPLS on an interface, label bindings and SR-MPLS policies need it, and only the system's globals owner creates it.

routes.title: Static label routes
routes.intro: A local label arriving in an MPLS table is forwarded on the route's paths: swap or push out labels towards a next hop, pop, or pop and look the IP packet up in a VRF.

bindings.title: Label bindings
bindings.intro: Binds a local label to an IP prefix; the label is installed in the default MPLS table.

tunnels.title: MPLS tunnels
tunnels.intro: Head-end LSPs as tunnel interfaces. The name is the tunnel interface's name: label routes can send packets into it.

sr.writeOnly: VPP has no way to read SR-MPLS policies and steering back: they are applied once per VPP start and are not shown in the live state or the drift view.
sr.intro: A policy is identified by its binding SID and sends traffic over one or more segment lists.
sr.steeringIntro: Traffic to a prefix enters the policy with this binding SID.

fib.title: MPLS FIB
fib.intro: The live MPLS forwarding table of one MPLS table, read from VPP on demand (each read walks the whole table; nothing refreshes by itself).
fib.label: Label

eos.title: End of stack
eos.help: off: the label has more labels under it

payload.title: Payload
payload.help: end-of-stack routes: ip4, ip6 or ethernet

paths.title: Paths
paths.help: several paths share the traffic by weight

outLabels.title: Out labels
outLabels.help: pushed labels, outermost first; empty = pop

vrf.title: Lookup VRF
vrf.help: pop and look the IP packet up in this VRF

prefix.title: Prefix
prefix.help: IP prefix the label is bound to

spray.title: Spray
spray.help: send on every list instead of load-balancing

prefix.title: Prefix
prefix.help: traffic to this prefix enters the policy
